transitions.promote: candidate with current exact evidence becomes active
transitions.repromote: new exact evidence creates a later active version
transitions.revoke: contradictory exact evidence removes row from active view

definitions.append_only: retrieve the first matching precedent forever
definitions.global_threshold: reuse Exp6264 global threshold on source energy
definitions.last_write_wins: retrieve the latest row without revocation state
definitions.revocable_atomic_repair_memory: retrieve active atomic repairs only with current exact evidence

exact_evidence_activation_contract.activation_rule: item exact_evidence_key must map to item exact_evidence_hash at retrieval time
